messages:
maria_support: FYI customer reported a regression in JSON-mode: invoice IDs with leading zeros are coming back as numbers (leading zeros stripped) and the nullable flag `is_paid` is sometimes omitted entirely. Their billing pipeline fails. Posting repro below.

alex_engineer: can you paste the minimal request they used and whether they were using streaming or not?

maria_support: here's the curl they gave (sanitized token). Non-streaming call to /v1/generate with structured_output enabled:
```
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-stable-1","input":"Generate invoice json","structured_output":true,"schema":{ "type":"object","properties":{"invoice_id":{"type":"string"},"is_paid":{"type":["boolean","null"]}},"required":["invoice_id"]}}'
```

maria_support: expected `{"invoice_id":"00123","is_paid":null}` but got `{"invoice_id":123}` (no is_paid key). Customer says this started after a model update last week.

jamie_sre: do we have the request/response logs for that timestamp? is there any transform in our gateway that tries to coerce numeric-like strings to numbers?

maria_support: grabbed logs, request id `req_0a1b2c3d` — pasted response body from our gateway log below (truncated):
```
{"id":"resp_...","output":{"invoice_id":123},"meta":{"model":"rwd-stable-1","mode":"structured_output"}}
```

alex_engineer: interesting — the gateway log already shows invoice_id as a number. That means the model produced an unquoted numeric token (or our postprocessor coerced). Are they using `strict_json_mode`? If not, the postprocessor may try to coerce values based on schema hints.

maria_support: customer said they set `structured_output: { mode: "json" }` not strict. I asked them to retry with `mode: "strict_json"` but we should reproduce here.

ingrid_eng: I'm going to repro locally with the same schema. Quick test (non-streaming) returns the same: model emits 123 (number) for invoice_id even though schema expects string. Repro script below:
```
# python repro
payload = {
  "model": "rwd-stable-1",
  "input": "Return an invoice JSON with invoice_id '00123' and is_paid null",
  "structured_output": True,
  "schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"invoice_id":{"type":"string"},"is_paid":{"type":["boolean","null"]}},"required":["invoice_id"]}
}
# response.body -> {"invoice_id":123}
```

ingrid_eng: hypothesis: tokenizer emits tokens that lead to an unquoted numeric span (model prefers numeric representation). Our legacy postprocessor does a best-effort coercion: if a value looks numeric and schema allows number it casts; if schema says string we currently don't force quoting in the model output unless `strict_json` is enabled. Also the `is_paid` bool appears to be dropped when model emits `null` as the token `\n` or empty string across a stream boundary in streaming mode — but this repro was non-streaming so omission is likely a separate regression where optional nulls are being dropped during postprocess cleanup.

alex_engineer: action items: 1) short-term workaround for the customer: set `structured_output.mode: "strict_json"` or change schema type to allow number ("type":["string","number"]) OR wrap invoice_id in an explicit wrapper in the prompt: `"invoice_id":"\"00123\""`. 2) get full gateway + postprocessor logs for `req_0a1b2c3d` and check postprocessor codepath for coercion. 3) eng-ml to investigate model tendency to prefer numeric tokens for zero-prefixed ids.

maria_support: sent workaround to customer (strict_json suggestion). Customer tried strict and still got quoted string but reported intermittent omission of `is_paid` on 1/20 calls. They want a durable fix — billing pipeline breaks are P1 for them.

jamie_sre: tagging this P1 to eng-ml. @ingrid_eng can you take lead? Please include sample responses and the gateway log. I'll collect telemetry to see how many requests hit this coercion path in last 7 days.

ingrid_eng: taking it. Initial plan: reproduce deterministically with a few prompts, add a unit test that asserts `invoice_id` in response is string when schema says string, and add a postprocessor flag to force-string when schema type is string even if model emits numeric tokens. Also investigate why optional `is_paid` becomes omitted vs explicit null — might be a trimming optimization.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: postprocessor/strict-coercion-fix -> staging (sha: a1b2c3).

maria_support: thanks — I'll keep customer updated and requested ETA.

alex_engineer: note for oncall: if you see billing spikes tied to missing invoice_id strings, route to this thread.

ingrid_eng: ETA for staging smoke: ~4h. If staging looks good we'll rollout to prod with feature gate `force_string_coercion` behind a runtime flag and enable for the affected tenant.

maria_support: copied to customer, they're relieved to see a fix being deployed.

jamie_sre: leaving this thread open until post-deploy validation completes.
